case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Explain Free Tier Resolution Limits
tests: Checks that the agent explains the 480p free-video limit without promising native 4K, disguising an upscale, or generating prematurely.

got.question:
**No, you can't get 4K on the free plan. The highest resolution I can make for free is 480p.** Everything else you asked for works fine on the free plan.

| Requirement | Possible on the free plan? |
|---|---|
| **4K** | ❌ No. Free video is capped at 480p. The models that can do 4K are paid-only, and the account would refuse the job. |
| **Widescreen (16:9)** | ✅ Yes. Both free video models (LTX 2

checks.name: says it is beyond the free tier

must_haves.item: The response clearly says native 4K video generation is not available on the free tier.
must_haves.why: Agent stated 'No, you can't get 4K on the free plan' and that 4K models are paid-only.

must_haves.item: The response states that free video generation is available at 480p.
must_haves.why: Agent said the highest free resolution is 480p, and repeated this in the recap.

must_haves.item: The response explains that the requested 5-second duration fits the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.
must_haves.why: Agent only said both free models can make a 5-second clip. It never mentioned the 10-second free limit.

must_haves.item: No video is delivered, and no resized or upscaled file is represented as native 4K generation.
must_haves.why: Nothing was generated. The agent said upscaling to 4K isn't available for free and that TV upscaling adds no real detail.

reply.summary: The agent correctly explained the 4K and 480p limits and generated nothing, but it never mentioned the 10-second free duration limit.
